summary: Grupo TMM S.A.B. filed a Form 6-K with its second quarter 2026 earnings press release. The release reports results in Mexican pesos, including revenue of Ps.261.1 million, operating income of Ps.26.3 million, and net income of Ps.34.3 million. Management discusses operational performance and outlook but announces no strategic transaction, corporate action, or special-situation event. This is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors. The filing is not a special situation; it is an ordinary periodic report.
